commands: base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/master) && changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base") && untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) || exit 1; for m in $(printf "%s\n%s\n" "$changed" "$untracked" | cut -d/ -f1 | sort -u); do [ -f "$m/package.json" ] || continue; echo "== $m"; (cd "$m" && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci; } && npm run --if-present typecheck && npx eslint . && npm run --if-present test:run && npm run build:dev) || exit 1; done
